scope: Independent local source reading, hashes and AST comparison only; no rerun of the 25 tests, native execution, device/model/private-store access or candidate modification.

findings.result: No additional IPC, capture, sink query or audio-worker timer is introduced. SelectedAudioOutput.read returns a shallow copy under its local lock; GStreamerAudioOutput.position consumes the same cached state. In the ordinary active/ready path the new LocalPortrait.read replaces the old ready property's own read. In idle there is one additional small cached-dict copy. Wall/CPU cost has not been measured.

TRANSCRIBING/GENERATING/PLAYING supply display-only waiting before or between stream events. Active sink + ready + audible + matching answer track + not paused/done/error is required to open eyes and forward the mouth envelope. Text/PCM arrival alone, feedback, PCM gaps and pauses remain closed with zero gain/level. Audio_sample comes from cached sink position; no wall-clock estimate or guessed answer track was added.

Cancel clears transcription_waiting then inherits stream removal, portrait invalidation, audio stop and generation change. Existing full-playback completion and acknowledgement remain inherited. StrictLocalPortrait rejects older generations; native owner/sequence/sample monotonic checks remain. The two cached snapshots are not atomic; a track transition can conservatively close one visual offer, but cannot authorize a mismatched answer interval. Completion can remain visually closed until the next existing transcription poll clears PLAYING; this does not hold the audio/ACK path.

Control/Stats layouts are preserved. Low-byte expressions remain 0..5; only authored/closed/open eye policies are allowed, with conflicting or unknown high bits rejected. New Python requires the exported capability before create. Native answer policy also requires answer track and a fresh <=150ms control, and stale/open-but-not-live controls close eyes and mouth. The matching new Python/library pair must be installed together.

The five-file renderer overlay has no file overlap with feature_trigger_collaboration/candidate_v2's seven files. Pair JSON differs from baseline only in tools/native_yuki.py and tools/libaura_yuki.so runtime pins; yuki_jobs_candidate.py is not a pair runtime pin. Formal image/persona code does not replace its instance-bound routing. Root must merge both overlays into the freshest runtime and update the combined source/config/startup fingerprints, including character_pair.selection_sha256=998710fc12bf442d6baea501bab0234665b666caa29f4be8f685741d50d82099. This is merge compatibility review, not independent functional acceptance of Version2.

acceptance_limits: Existing native receipt is a real Host CPU parameter-policy test with a GPU-free Renderer substitute: 640 thinking, 64 answer, 640 idle frames; it is not rendered image, wall-clock 16fps, EGL swap or physical lip-sync acceptance.
The native frame scheduler is AST-identical and target remains 16fps. Added three-parameter facial adjustment cost is unmeasured; no FPS or CPU improvement is claimed.
Frozen initial HANDOFF/source manifest predate the successful build/seal. Use the separately verified build and pairing receipts for those later facts.
